summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 5,000,000 of its ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International on June 25, 2026, at a VWAP of 109.5 pence per share. These purchases are part of an existing share buyback programme announced on January 30, 2026, and shares will be cancelled. This is a routine open-market buyback, not a classified special situation such as a tender offer or going-private transaction. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is a standard issuer share repurchase under a pre-announced programme.
